decision: Use Redis Caching for Inventory Counts
outcome: Cache desynchronization caused inventory errors and duplicate sales.
lesson: Never cache transactional database states in Redis without implementing strict event-driven cache invalidation or Pub/Sub cache invalidation triggers.

decision: Global Vector Search without Session Metadata Filtering
outcome: Critical security finding where standard employees retrieved restricted salary and HR documents via natural language semantic queries (BOLA bypass).
lesson: Mandate Row-Level Security (RLS) or enforce metadata pre-filtering on the vector database session level using the authenticated user's authorized IDs.

decision: Synchronous Media File Uploads and Processing
outcome: Severe API Gateway timeouts (504) and thread pool exhaustion when large claims audio files were processed directly on main worker threads.
lesson: Enforce direct-to-storage uploads via presigned URLs and run ingestion processing completely asynchronously via background job queues, immediately returning a 202 Accepted status.

decision: Direct video uploads to backend API instances
outcome: Application crashed with Out-Of-Memory (OOM) errors during peak concurrent usage.
lesson: Bypass application servers for large binary payloads. Clients should upload directly to AWS S3 / Cloud Storage using presigned URLs, then fire a lightweight notification trigger.
